headline: Houthis Seize Area Overlooking Strategic Bab el-Mandeb Strait
summary: Forces loyal to Yemen's internationally recognized government withdrew from an area overlooking the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, handing tactical control of the critical shipping chokepoint to Houthi rebels.
why: The Bab el-Mandeb Strait connects the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden, a vital trade route through which substantial volumes of crude oil and containerized commerce transit.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Houthi control over high ground above the Bab el-Mandeb chokepoint raises geopolitical risks for tanker transit.
